purpose: Define deterministic verification of manifest/member hashes, expected package identity and structural completeness before package acceptance.

topics.name: Package Integrity Verification
topics.purpose: Define deterministic verification of manifest/member hashes, expected package identity and structural completeness before package acceptance.

semantics.extra_rule: Unexpected extra members follow explicit allow/reject policy.
semantics.evidence_rule: Verification result references exact package/artifact revisions.
semantics.execution_rule: Integrity validation never executes package contents.
semantics.authority_rule: Valid integrity does not imply trusted publisher/certified/license-entitled/install-authorized.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.
